item.title: GAELS BACK IN THE WIN COLUMN WITH 84-55 VICTORY AGAINST VARSITY BLUES
item.description: The Queen's Gaels picked up an 84-55 win against the Toronto Varsity Blues on Saturday afternoon on the road. Coming off their first loss of the season last night, the Gaels demonstrated resilience by entering this game on a clean slate and earning themselves the win. The Gaels showed impressive offensive depth, with four players earning more than 10 points, and 29 points coming from the bench. item.title: GAELS EMERGE VICTORIOUS IN 85-82 NAIL-BITER AGAINST VARSITY BLUES
item.description: The Queen's Gaels defeated the Toronto Varsity Blues 85-82 on Saturday night on the road in a closely contended game. The Gaels' offense was led by second year Ollie Engen (Kinesiology) with 21 points and 6 rebounds. Alongside their teammate were first years Inder Brar (Arts) and Jakub Dobiech (Arts) with with 15 and 13 points, respectively. As a team, Queen's made 36 rebounds, 6 steals, 30 points in the paint, and 30 points from the bench.

item.title: Gaels Earn Straight-Sets Win Over McMaster on Senior Night
item.description: The Queen's Gaels women's volleyball team earned a straight-sets victory over the McMaster Marauders on Saturday, January 31, in a special Senior Night matchup at home. The Gaels delivered a composed and competitive performance with set wins of 26-24, 26-24, and 25-21, closing out the match in three tightly contested sets.

item.title: 2026 season ticket packages for defending Yates Cup champion Queen’s Football on sale NOW
item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Causeway Clash: Queen’s and RMC commemorate 140-years of rivalry, in 2026 Carr-Harris Cup
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey and their crosstown rivals, the RMC Paladins, will clash on the ice for the second time this regular season on Saturday, Feb. 7. This time, however, the matchup moves beyond the historic confines of Memorial Centre and the close-quarters intensity of Constantine Arena to the bright lights of Slush Puppie Place downtown, and with a trophy in the building and citywide bragging rights on the line.

item.title: Gaels Win Five-Set Senior Night Match Over McMaster
item.description: The Queen's Gaels men's volleyball team earned a thrilling five-set victory over the McMaster Marauders on Saturday, January 31, in a special Senior Night game at home. The Gaels showed resilience and composure to rally for a 3-2 win, taking the match by set scores of 21-25, 23-25, 25-13, 25-20, and 15-10.

item.title: Pascale Galarneau, Reed Venning named Queen's Varsity Student-Athletes of the Week
item.description: Pascale Galarneau and Reed Venning have been named the Queen's University Varsity Student-Athletes of the Week for their performances this past weekend.

item.title: Queen's Distance Track's Jude Wheeler-Dee sets history and runs fastest time in the nation
item.description: Queen's Distance Track had a successful weekend competing as the only non-NCAA Division One school competing at the Cornell Invitational. Queen's placed third in the seven school event, behind host Cornell and the University of Albany.

item.title: Queen's Women's Rugby Head Coach Dan Valley named Attack Coach for Canada's National U21 squad
item.description: Queen's Women's Rugby Head Coach Dan Valley was named the Attack Coach for Canada's National U21 squad by Rugby Canada.
